total_revenue.description: Sum of all revenue across all transactions
total_revenue.sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales

total_units.description: Sum of all units sold across all transactions
total_units.sql: SELECT SUM(units) AS total_units FROM sales

average_revenue.sql: SELECT AVG(revenue) AS average_revenue FROM sales

date_filters.last month: date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
date_filters.last quarter: date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AND date < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE)
date_filters.this quarter: date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AND date < DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH

sales.description: Sales transaction data including revenue and units sold by region and product

region.description: The geographical region of the sale (e.g., North, South)

account.description: The name of the customer company (e.g., Acme Corp, Globex, Initech, Soylent, Stark Ind)

product.description: The item that was sold (e.g., Widget A, Widget B, Widget C)

revenue.description: The total monetary value of the sale

units.description: The physical number of items sold
